title: Fix packaged Tauri backend import root and stale advisory tests
summary: Fixed packaged Tauri shell backend startup by deriving the apps/desktop root without a literal tauri\.. segment, so the shell builds PYTHONPATH from the package root src folder. Also made debug-only WebView helpers release-clean, refreshed the Tauri required-route contract, normalized effective audio language aliases, and updated stale advisory tests to the current MP4 compatibility policy.
reason: Fresh-package package-mode validation failed because the Tauri shell passed apps\desktop\tauri\.. as the desktop root. project_root_from_desktop_root then derived apps\desktop as the project root, so Python could not import mediapipeline.desktop.local_api_main from the package root src folder.
behavior_before: A portable package built with -IncludeTauriPreviewBinary passed package hygiene checks but the packaged Tauri launch/close smoke failed before showing a window with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mediapipeline'.
behavior_after: The packaged Tauri executable resolves apps/desktop directly from an executable located under apps/desktop/tauri, derives the package root correctly, sets PYTHONPATH to package-root/src, starts the backend, opens a visible shell window, and closes the shell/backend through the packaged launch smoke.
tests_added: Added Rust regression coverage for packaged apps/desktop/tauri executable root candidates deriving package-root PYTHONPATH.
